config.smoothcam.speed.name: Follow speed
config.smoothcam.speed.tooltip: Smooth mode only. How quickly the camera catches up while moving. Lower = smoother/more trailing; 1.0 = instant.
config.debug.name: Debug logging
config.debug.tooltip: Log render-pipeline info to the SMAPI console to help troubleshoot.
config.wip.text:
These effects are planned but not implemented yet, so they have no settings here:
- Color grading & fog / god rays
- Cloud shadows & tilt-shift (DynamicShader parity)
- Water enhancement, vignette, chromatic aberration, depth of field
- Dynamic 2D lighting with soft shadows
- High-quality texture upscaling
Each effect will get its own options as it lands.
